answer: Identities funded from a common source within 22 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the crystal graph is rebuilt each epoch, the meadow merge is applied at settlement and the dune audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet as a result collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 32 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
